name: ce42-next
description: Modern, open re-implementation of the Vertex Standard CE42 programming software for the VX-1210 HF transceiver
author: PP5KJ <contato@pp5kj.com>

scripts.test: npm run test -w @ce42/core && npm run test -w @ce42/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ce42/core && npm run typecheck -w @ce42/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @ce42/web && npm run start -w @ce42/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build -w @ce42/web && npm run dist -w @ce42/desktop
